title.narrative: Research, Compilation and Exhibition of Intangible Heritages (Traditional Festivals) Around the Temple Complex of Sambor Prei Kuk, Kampong Thom Province

description.narrative: The submission of this project aims to contribute to the protection of the intangible cultural heritage around the temple complex of Sambor Prei Kuk, which is facing constant loss. The traditional festivals of the locals around this area, whether Khmer or Kuoy ethnic group, all show a unique culture different from other areas in Cambodia that should not be overlooked. The research and compilation to publish of an inventory book and the storing of these data on the website, as well as the installation of an exhibition on intangible cultural heritage in the Kampong Thom provincial museum, that are part of this project could be a great way to protect these heritages. It is an image to promote, value and motivate people in the community to continue to worship this valuable cultural resource and it is a significant part of helping the general public to freely explore this cultural heritage.
